notes: GS LiveUpdate is fixed. The in-app updater now resumes downloads from the exact byte a dropped connection broke at instead of restarting at 1%, only ever runs one download at a time, and verifies every package before the system installer sees it (ZIP magic, a real package-manager parse, our own signature identity, and the full advertised byte length) — so a truncated download can never again end in 'problem parsing the package'. When a download genuinely cannot finish, the pill says so and stays tappable to resume; nothing dissolves into nothing. Everything else in the app is untouched.
